title: Spells give no keyword to a Unit Immune to Spells
notes: A Spell's "your Units have X" (the War Doctrines, TG #39's army) now passes a Unit Immune to Spells by, read live, while a later Unit still takes the keyword (R4508000); S #150's Allure passes it by (R4453000); the fuzz monitor's I21 and a sweep of every Spell hold it.

player.title: Immune to Spells holds against more Spells
fixes: The War Doctrines and Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition) no longer give their keyword to a Unit Immune to Spells; your other Units, and the ones you play later, still get it.
Call to Chaos (Stinky Edition)'s Allure no longer reaches a Unit Immune to Spells.
